About
Incorporated in 2013, Euro Panel Products
Ltd manufactures and supplies Aluminium Composite Panels in India and abroad

Key Points
History and Group structure:
[1]
The EUROBOND brand entered India's
aluminium composite panel market
in 2002. A J&K factory was started
in 2006 and EPPL acquired the brand
in 2013 and began manufacturing at
Umbergaon in 2015.
EPPL has a wholly owned subsidiary
viz. Qatar trading company and Eurobond
Dimensions, a 70%-owned subsidiary
formed on 15.07.2026. It also has ~51%
owned Euro Sealant.
